comment: Wind in the vegetation (Wind.cs, shader Pokescrap/Sprite-Lit-Wind; GDD, 'Jour et nuit'): the decor elements of map_props.json sway, `amplitude` pixels at the top of the sprite for each group (0: still; a group not listed: default). calm: strength of the breeze; storm: strength while a storm blows (Climate.WindNow), lean: pixels they lean towards it (× amplitude); speed: radians a second of the swing; max: pixels at most (the transparent margin of the sprites, extract_map_props.py). The leaves (ambient.json, `wind`) drift with the storms too.
